modmenu.descriptionTranslation.max-level: Enchantments on villagers' traded enchanted books, weapons, armor and tools are always max-level, and zombie villager cure time is reduced to 5 seconds.
text.autoconfig.max-level-enchanting.opt:
When enabled, enchanted books, weapons, armor, tools and bows/crossbows sold by villagers are always generated at the highest enchantment level.
Disable to restore vanilla random enchantment levels.

When enabled, after a zombie villager eats a golden apple with weakness applied,
its cure (conversion back to villager) countdown is shortened to the seconds configured below.

The zombie villager cure countdown in seconds (ticks = seconds × 20).
Set to 0 or lower to disable and keep the vanilla cure duration.

When enabled, only vanilla (minecraft namespace) enchantments are raised to max level.
Custom enchantments added by other mods keep their original level.
